desc: Characterize via max Cartesian tree: subtree intervals, can_start from original immediate neighbors, upward propagation with strict `>`.
Implement the O(N) iterative max Cartesian tree + linear reach DP with fast I/O.
Brute-force verification: simulate exhaustively for small N against the DP, confirm samples and edge families match with no counterexample.
Confirm O(N) performance and Python int safety for N = 5e5, A_i up to 1e9.
